review.notes: Structure scan of the whole OCR markdown: no code fences, no fence swallowing of headings/tables/images, and the language-list appendix headings are legitimate sections. Automated droppage scan of all 12 physical pages (condensed-text window containment): hits triaged to the arXiv cover stamp, running page headers, Figure 1-4 image-internal chart labels and prompt artwork (pp.3, 4, 6 windows), and HTML table cell-order differences — Tables 1-4 and the prompt-template table were verified present with matching values (e.g. Table 1 27B rows; Table 3 MQM English-Italian 18/20/25; Table 4 en-ar 25.4/27.8/35.7). The reference list was verified complete, including the Barma et al. SMOL entry whose author string triggered scan hits on p.8. Real defects: the p.2 footnote 1 (marker and body both dropped), the p.5 footnote 2 body (marker survives), the nine Contributor names under the empty '## Contributors' heading, and the 'Now at Anthropic.' footnote for the $^{*}$ marker on Geza Kovacs. All four were verified on rendered pages (220/200/250 dpi). The cover line 'Corresponding author(s): vilar@google.com. See Contributions section for full author list.' and the copyright/arXiv stamp lines are cover boilerplate the OCR omitted; recorded as unresolved rather than patched. Figure 2's table of scores is image-internal while Table 1/2 carry the same numbers as HTML.
